decks.notes: The primary focus of this Grixis Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence through aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, while also disrupting the opponent with cards like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to control the game tempo with efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Dragon's Rage Channeler, and card selection/card advantage spells like Brainstorm and Ponder. Additionally, the deck utilizes Mishra's Bauble to gain information about the opponent's next draw. Overall, the deck combines aggression and disruption to secure a victory.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 Combo - Mississippi River deck is to utilize cards that allow for random effects and chaos, such as Call Forth the Tempest, Tibalt's Trickery, and Throes of Chaos, in order to quickly ramp up mana and play powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Apex Devastator. The deck also includes ways to cheat in big creatures with spells like Violent Outburst and Creative Technique. The land base is designed to provide fast and efficient mana to support the combo strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly cascade into powerful threats, overwhelming the opponent with aggressive plays while keeping control of the game with counterspells and disruptive spells. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into cards like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The deck also utilizes cards like Force of Will and Mystical Dispute to protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes a mix of land destruction and versatile removal spells to control the battlefield.

The main focus of this deck is to efficiently control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating value through creature recursion and tutoring. The deck utilizes a mix of mana dorks, powerful creatures, and efficient removal spells to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent. By ramping into threats like Craterhoof Behemoth and Grist, the Hunger Tide, while disrupting the opponent with cards like Endurance and Collector Ouphe, the deck aims to establish a dominant board presence and ultimately overpower the opponent.

The deck focuses on using efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the right cards at the right time. Wasteland is used to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while Unholy Heat provides additional removal. The deck aims to control the game tempo and close out the game quickly with its aggressive threats.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively control the game by utilizing cheap and efficient threats like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler. This deck aims to disrupt opponents with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will while also maintaining card advantage through cards like Mishra's Bauble and Brainstorm. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's aggressive and tempo-focused strategy.

The strategy of this deck revolves around using lands to control the game and disrupt the opponent's plans. By using cards like Life from the Loam and Exploration to maximize land drops, along with cards like Wasteland and Ghost Quarter to disrupt the opponent's mana base, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent. With key cards like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage for a potential game-winning combo, as well as cards like Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale and Maze of Ith for protection, this deck excels at controlling the game and grinding out wins.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly dump powerful creatures into the graveyard using cards like Grief and Entomb, and then bring them back onto the battlefield using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. This combo-focused strategy aims to overwhelm the opponent with high-impact creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes disruption spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces, while utilizing cards like Brainstorm and Ponder for additional consistency and card selection. Additionally, the deck features a strong mana base with fetch lands and dual lands for optimal mana fixing.

The deck focuses on using various forms of ramp and land tutoring to quickly assemble the Dark Depths/Thespian's Stage combo, allowing for a fast win condition. Additionally, the deck includes disruption in the form of Swords to Plowshares and Endurance to deal with opposing threats. Green Sun's Zenith and Once Upon a Time provide consistency in finding key pieces, with additional utility from cards like Elvish Reclaimer and Knight of the Reliquary. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This deck aims to quickly assemble a winning combo using Doomsday, combining cards like Thassa's Oracle and Street Wraith to manipulate the top of the deck and win the game in one turn. It includes powerful disruption like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo, alongside cards like Brainstorm and Ponder for consistency. The deck also incorporates mana acceleration with Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual, allowing for explosive plays. The inclusion of Personal Tutor and Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional search and control tools to ensure the combo can be assembled efficiently and safely.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and disruptive spells like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void to lock down the opponent's mana base and disrupt their game plan. By utilizing powerful threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Fury, this deck aims to quickly apply pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they can recover. The combination of mana acceleration, disruptive elements, and efficient threats makes this deck a formidable force in the Legacy format, capable of overwhelming opponents with its aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on flooding the board with aggressive Goblin creatures and overwhelming the opponent with a fast and powerful assault. By utilizing cards like Chalice of the Void to disrupt the opponent's strategy and Chrome Mox to accelerate their own, the deck aims to quickly build a formidable army and close out the game. Cards like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and Battle Cry Goblin provide additional firepower, while cards like City of Traitors and Ancient Tomb help to ramp up mana production for explosive turns. The deck's singular goal is to win as fast and decisively as possible.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive goblin tribal strategy. By utilizing cards like Muxus, Goblin Grandee, Legion Warboss, Goblin Rabblemaster, and Broadside Bombardiers, the deck aims to flood the board with powerful goblin creatures that can quickly deal damage to the opponent. Using cards like Chalice of the Void and Simian Spirit Guide for early disruption and acceleration, the deck seeks to establish board presence and maintain pressure throughout the game. With a focus on efficiency and speed, the deck aims to outpace the opponent and secure a victory through sheer aggression.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced goblin aggro strategy, utilizing cards like Legion Warboss, Goblin Rabblemaster, and Muxus, Goblin Grandee to quickly build a threatening board presence. Other cards like Chalice of the Void and Chrome Mox provide additional support and disruption to control the game. With a high number of aggressive creatures and mana acceleration, the deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The key concept of this deck is to assemble the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's library. Additionally, the deck uses cards like Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to support the combo and protect it with cards like Red Elemental Blast and Pyroblast. The deck also includes cards like Fury and Lightning Bolt for removal, as well as some powerful artifacts like Mox Opal and Ancient Tomb for ramp and acceleration. The overall strategy revolves around quickly setting up the combo and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Grief, then bringing them back onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes some utility creatures like Brazen Borrower and Orcish Bowmasters to deal with specific threats. The mana base provides the necessary colors to cast the spells efficiently.
